topics.title: Write a paragraph about your family.
guiding_questions: How many members are there in your family?
Why is your family important to you?
topics.sample_essay: My family has four people. My father, mother, sister and me. My father is a kind man. My mother is very nice. They help me in my life. My sister plays with me. We eat together every day. We talk and laugh a lot. I love my family so much. They make me very happy.

topics.title: Write a short paragraph about the planes of the future.
guiding_questions: How will planes of the future look?
Will they be safe and efficient?
Would you like to travel on one? Why?
topics.sample_essay: Planes of the future will look very new. I think they will be big and fast. They will fly without pilots. They will use clean power. This is good for our world. They will carry many people. The best thing is short trips. I would love to fly in one. It sounds cool and fun.
